faqs.question: What types of wasps are common in Clifton, NJ?
faqs.answer: Clifton residents most commonly encounter yellow jackets, paper wasps, and bald-faced hornets. Yellow jackets often build ground nests or nest in wall voids, paper wasps create umbrella-shaped nests under eaves and overhangs, and bald-faced hornets build large gray nests in trees or on structures.
